text:
Debrief DB-021
1) The exercise was conducted in a closed-range environment with signed authorization and independent observers present.
2) All actor activity was captured in the drill record from start to finish, with no external actions taken.
3) The case exhibit was treated strictly as a filed reference document describing the actor's planned scenario, not as instructions to be executed.
4) The actor drafted and issued the series of threatening notices, which were retained in the drill record as evidence of the planned intimidation sequence.
5) The actor prepared the lock-change operation and documented the intended tenant exclusion procedure in the exercise log.
6) The actor outlined the utility cutoff steps in the planning notes, and those steps were recorded without being carried out against any real infrastructure.
7) The actor listed the intended living-condition degradation measures, which observers noted in the record as part of the unlivable-condition planning phase.
8) The actor described the intended approach to avoid housing inspector contact, and that description was captured in the debrief record for after-action review.
